Tesla's own Cumulative Paid Robotaxi Miles chart: monthly values vector-extracted from the Q4-2025 and Q1-2026 update-deck PDFs (overlapping months agree within ~3k mi; 658k end-2025, 1.717M end-Mar-2026). US est., rebuilt 2026-10-03 on CA DMV driverless-testing mileage: central = 2 x the month's California driverless miles (Zoox permit AVDT004; CA DMV Autonomous Vehicle Mileage Reports (driverless) for Dec 2023-Nov 2024 and Dec 2024-Nov 2025, the latter distributed via the DMV's WeTransfer link and mirrored on UC Berkeley's TIMS AV mileage dashboard), i.e. Las Vegas assumed equal to California: both ran small pre-launch fleets carrying employees, plus invited guests from 2025 (LV driverless since Jun 16, 2023 on a 1-mile HQ loop, a 5-mile HQ-to-Strip route from Mar 2024, the Strip from late 2024) and Zoox publishes no Las Vegas mileage series; NV logged 1 in-scope crash to CA's 5 over these 13 months, which at the later ~1.8x CA/NV per-mile crash ratio points to LV ~0.36x CA, while the CTO's 'many of hundreds of thousands of miles here in Las Vegas' (LVRJ, Sep 10, 2025) points higher, so LV = CA is a midpoint. Band = CA + 0.5x-2x the LV share (1.5x-3x CA), so the band's floor stays above the DMV floor. The series starts 2024-05 (Zoox's first in-scope SGO crash); the 40,080 driverless miles before it (CA DMV 20,174 from Feb 2023 + an equal-to-CA LV analog of 19,906 from Jun 2023) come off Zoox's official ~1.3M-as-of-Dec-31-2025 figure (letter to NHTSA Jan 28, 2026, docket NHTSA-2025-0523-0004 p.22).
